about_the_game:
Third Birth – DLC for Retro Space Shooter 8-Bit

Join James on a desperate mission inside a building haunted by evil.

"Third Birth" expands the Retro Space Shooter 8-Bit universe with a dark and intense new chapter. This time, you’re not in space—you’re trapped inside a decaying building swarming with mysterious, deadly creatures. As James, a young survivor armed only with his shotgun and courage, you’ll explore shadowy halls, face waves of monsters, and try to find a way out… if there is one.

With a playtime of 10–15 minutes, this short but intense DLC immerses you in fast-paced action with a creepy, retro-horror vibe, entirely presented in pixel art.

Key Features:

  • New dark setting: A rundown, abandoned building full of danger and secrets.

  • Direct action gameplay: Shoot, survive, and escape in a fast but focused experience.

  • Retro style: Classic pixel art, reimagined with eerie and ominous environments.

  • Immersive sound: A tense, moody soundtrack that keeps you on edge from start to finish.

  • Playtime: Short and powerful — perfect for a single horror arcade session (10–15 min).

Story:

James is alone. No communication. No explanation. Just a voice in his head whispering: “Run… or fight.”
After entering what looked like an empty building, he quickly realizes he’s not alone. Deformed creatures emerge from the shadows. His only hope? A shotgun, a few rounds, and a strong will to survive.
Each room tells a forgotten story. Each monster hides a secret. And James… might not make it out.

Perfect for players who enjoy:

  • Retro-style arcade action

  • Light horror with pixel visuals

  • Short but intense game sessions

  • Shooting-based combat

  • Claustrophobic, immersive exploration

Prepare for the Third Birth.
The mission isn't in space anymore. It's inside the nightmare.
